# Dutch learning resources (@dutchlearning)

> A free, independent finder for ways to learn Dutch: libraries, city halls, language schools, universities, apps, online tutors, Instagram and YouTube teachers and practice groups in the Netherlands, Belgium, Taiwan and online. Run by Inka (Instagram @dutchlearning). No ads or paid placements. Prices are checked every week.

The site is available in English (https://www.dutchlearningresources.com/), Traditional Chinese (https://www.dutchlearningresources.com/zh/) and simple Dutch (https://www.dutchlearningresources.com/nl/). Visitors filter by current and target CEFR level (A0–C2), monthly budget, time per month, learning format, skills, region and Dutch or Flemish.

Last price check: 2026-10-26. Prices change; always confirm on the provider's website.

## Resources

- [Taalhuis (Bibliotheek)](https://www.bibliotheek.nl/): Most Dutch public libraries run a Taalhuis: a free drop-in desk that matches you with a course, a volunteer language buddy or a study group. Libraries can also lend NT2 textbooks. Levels A0–B1. Netherlands (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Den Haag, Utrecht, Eindhoven, Groningen, Leiden). In-person class. Price: Free. Library membership may be needed to borrow books.
- [Taalcafé](https://rotterdamstyle.com/education/practise-dutch-at-the-taalcafe-in-rotterdam): Informal conversation tables run by libraries, community centres and city halls. You need some basic Dutch (around A1) to join in. Search "taalcafé" plus your city. Levels A1–B2. Netherlands, Belgium (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Den Haag, Utrecht, Eindhoven, Antwerpen, Gent, Brussel). In-person class. Price: Usually free, no booking needed.
- [Inburgering via your gemeente](https://www.inburgeren.nl/en/): If you are required to complete civic integration (Wet inburgering 2021), your city hall arranges and pays for your learning route to B1. Volunteers who aren't required can sometimes join, or borrow from DUO. Levels A0–B1. Netherlands (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Den Haag, Utrecht, Eindhoven, Groningen, Leiden). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Free if your gemeente is responsible for your integration; otherwise a DUO loan is possible.
- [Naar Nederland](https://www.naarnederland.nl/): The Dutch government's free self-study pack for the civic integration exam abroad: a film about life in the Netherlands, practice exercises and the A1 speaking test format. Levels A0–A1. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free.
- [Oefenen.nl](https://oefenen.nl/): Free online exercise programmes from Stichting Expertisecentrum Oefenen.nl, built for adults learning everyday Dutch. Short videos with practical topics such as doctors, shopping and work. Levels A0–A2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free.
- [Het Begint met Taal](https://hetbegintmettaal.nl/): A national network of organisations that pair newcomers with a volunteer taalmaatje (language buddy) for weekly conversation practice. Levels A1–B1. Netherlands (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Den Haag, Utrecht, Eindhoven, Groningen, Leiden). In-person class. Price: Free.
- [NOS Journaal in Makkelijke Taal](https://nos.nl/l/2536458): The national broadcaster's news in easy Dutch: fewer topics, slower pace and every hard word explained. Episodes are also on YouTube. Levels A2–B1. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free.
- [NOS Jeugdjournaal](https://jeugdjournaal.nl/): Daily news for children, with clear speech and short articles. A favourite stepping stone between textbook Dutch and the regular news. Levels A2–B2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free.
- [NPO Start](https://npo.nl/start): Dutch public TV on demand. Turn on Dutch subtitles to train your ear on real series, documentaries and talk shows. Levels B1–C2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Much is free; NPO Plus removes ads and unlocks the archive.
- [VRT MAX](https://www.vrt.be/vrtmax/): Flemish public TV on demand: series, documentaries, news and kids' shows in Belgian Dutch. Turn on Dutch subtitles with the CC button to train your ear. Levels B1–C2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free with a free VRT profile. Without a Belgian address, many programmes are blocked for rights reasons; VRT's own productions can be watched from anywhere.
- [Wablieft](https://wablieft.be/nl/abonnement): A Flemish newspaper written in clear, simple Dutch. Good weekly reading practice if you live in Belgium or want Flemish vocabulary. Levels A2–B1. Belgium. Self-paced. Price: Digital subscription €20 a year, covering Wablieft and Wablieft Start. Paper copies can no longer be ordered.
- [Huis van het Nederlands Brussel](https://www.huisnederlandsbrussel.be/): Free advice and a placement test, then they point you to the right course in Brussels, free or paid, in person or online. They also list practice activities like theatre and conversation groups. Levels A0–C1. Belgium (Brussel). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Advice is free; the courses they refer you to vary.
- [Atlas Antwerpen](https://www.atlas-antwerpen.be/): Antwerp's integration and Dutch-learning centre. Book an intake to get matched with a course and practice opportunities in the city. Levels A0–C1. Belgium (Antwerpen). In-person class. Price: Intake and advice are free.
- [CVO adult education centres](https://www.vlaanderen.be/onderwijs-en-vorming/school-en-studiekosten/kosten-volwassenenonderwijs): Flemish government-funded adult education centres (Centra voor Volwassenenonderwijs) offer full NT2 courses at subsidised prices. Your Huis van het Nederlands or Atlas can refer you. Levels A0–C1. Belgium (Antwerpen, Gent, Brussel, Leuven). In-person class, Live online class. Price: €1.50 per lesson hour at the first level (max €180 in total), €0.60 per hour at higher levels, €0.30 with some reductions. Free with an inburgering contract or certificate. Books are extra.
- [VDAB Nederlands leren](https://www.vdab.be/anderstalig/nederlands): The Flemish employment service offers free Dutch courses for jobseekers, including a track for highly educated newcomers (Hogerop NT2). Levels A0–B2. Belgium (Antwerpen, Gent, Leuven). Self-paced, In-person class, Live online class. Price: Free for registered jobseekers.
- [Oefenkansen](https://www.oefenkansen.be/): A free Flemish guide to informal practice opportunities: no lessons, just ideas and places to use your Dutch in clubs, cafés and volunteering. Levels A1–B2. Belgium (Antwerpen, Gent, Brussel, Leuven). In-person class. Price: Free.
- [Volksuniversiteit](https://www.volksuniversiteit.nl/): Affordable evening group courses run by local non-profits in most Dutch cities. Prices and schedules differ per city. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Den Haag, Utrecht, Eindhoven, Groningen, Leiden). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Den Haag A1: €265 for 8 × 3 h (autumn 2026). Amsterdam A0–A1: €528.
- [UvA Talen](https://www.uvatalen.nl/nederlands): The University of Amsterdam's language centre, open to everyone. Courses from beginner to B2, e-learning, writing and fluency courses, and Staatsexamen preparation. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Amsterdam). Self-paced, In-person class, Live online class. Price: Per course: e-learning from €195, Staatsexamen prep and Fluency Skills from €485, Writing Skills from €710, Beginners intensive (A0–A2) from €815. Materials €30–48 extra.
- [Babel (Utrecht)](https://www.babel.nl/cursus/): A language school in Utrecht with Dutch courses from beginner to C1, in the classroom or a virtual classroom, plus conversation courses, e-learning and Staatsexamen training. Levels A0–C1. Netherlands (Utrecht). Self-paced, In-person class, Live online class. Price: Per course: e-learning from €225, conversation €295, A0–A1 €550, advanced 9-week courses €795, full A0–A2 or B1–B2 €1,075, Staatsexamen training €565–590.
- [EUR Language & Training Centre](https://www.eur.nl/onderwijs/taal-trainingscentrum/nederlands/nederlands-a1-beginners): Erasmus University Rotterdam's Dutch courses, open to all. International EUR students pay a heavily reduced fee once per level. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Rotterdam). In-person class. Price: €50 per level for international EUR students; regular price higher.
- [In'to Languages (Wageningen)](https://www.wur.nl/nl/onderwijs/into-languages): Wageningen University's language centre, including social Dutch courses and intensive summer courses. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Wageningen). In-person class, Live online class. Price: €100–€300 per month.
- [KU Leuven ILT](https://ilt.kuleuven.be/cursus/nt2_prijs_voorwaarden.php): KU Leuven's Institute for Living Languages teaches Dutch in six levels in small groups, plus pronunciation and online writing classes and a summer course. Open to adults outside the university. Levels A0–C2. Belgium (Leuven). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Per module: €300 (levels 1–3) or €320 (levels 4–6) for external students, €175–195 for KU Leuven students and staff, syllabus included. Summer course €460–480. Free for Erasmus students.
- [UCT Gent](https://www.uct.ugent.be/en): Ghent University's language centre teaches Dutch from level 1 (A1) to level 6 (C1), as intensive day courses or evening courses, open to residents as well as students. Levels A1–C1. Belgium (Gent). In-person class. Price: Per course: €588 standard, €520 for UGent staff and PhD students, €400 for UGent students.
- [Linguapolis (University of Antwerp)](https://www.uantwerpen.be/en/centres/linguapolis/language-courses/languages/dutch/tariffs-and-subsidies2/): The University of Antwerp's language institute, with Dutch courses for students, expats and professionals, plus a one-year academic Dutch programme. Levels A0–C1. Belgium (Antwerpen). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Standard rate €555 for a 45-hour course, €750 for 90 hours (2026–2027). A Flemish training voucher can cover up to €125; level 1 may qualify for a Flemish grant.
- [Regina Coeli](https://www.reginacoeli.com/language-courses/fees.html): A well-known residential language institute in Vught: full-immersion training, mostly one-to-one, often paid for by employers. Also runs small evening groups at High Tech Campus Eindhoven. Levels A0–C1. Netherlands (Vught, Eindhoven). In-person class. Price: Intensive week (5 days) €5,315 excl. VAT, overnight stay extra. Evening course in Eindhoven €1,135 excl. VAT for 12 two-hour lessons over 6 weeks, groups of 5.
- [Direct Dutch Institute](https://directdutch.com/courses/): A private language school in The Hague for expats, with in-person and online group courses from A0 to B2, a B1+ writing course and two-week intensives. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Den Haag). In-person class, Live online class. Price: A1 or A2 in person €645 for 7 weeks. B1 online or B2 €780 for 12 weeks. A2+ and B1+ writing €480 for 8 weeks. Two-week intensives €865–€1,395. Course material included.
- [Koentact](https://koentact.nl/): An Amsterdam language school with small group courses (5–12 students), a conversation course and one-week intensives (max 6 students). Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Amsterdam). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Morning or evening group course €525 (8 lessons + 2 field trips over 4 weeks). Conversation course (A2–B1) €320. Intensive week €975 (33 hours in 6 days). Discount when you prepay 3 courses.
- [Introduction to Dutch (University of Groningen)](https://www.futurelearn.com/courses/dutch): A free beginner MOOC on FutureLearn from the University of Groningen, covering basic words, sentences and Dutch culture. Levels A0–A1. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free to audit; paid upgrade for unlimited access and a certificate.
- [TU Delft Dutch courses](https://www.tudelft.nl/tbm/itav/onderwijs/nederlands-nt2/nederlandse-cursussen): TU Delft's language centre runs Dutch courses from beginner to advanced, a summer school, NT2 State Exam preparation and a free online beginners course. Open to non-students too. Levels A0–C1. Netherlands (Delft). Self-paced, In-person class, Live online class. Price: Online beginners course free. Semi-intensive courses €445–€485, advanced intensive €910, summer school €550 per level (materials extra). Some levels free for TU Delft students in English-taught programmes.
- [Staatsexamen NT2 practice exams](https://www.staatsexamensnt2.nl/): Official free practice exams for the State Exam Dutch as a Second Language (programme I at B1, programme II at B2). Essential if a job or university needs the certificate. Levels A2–C1. Online. Self-paced. Price: Practice material is free; taking the exam costs a fee per part.
- [DutchGrammar.com](https://www.dutchgrammar.com/): Clear grammar explanations in English with exercises. The go-to reference when a rule in class doesn't click. Levels A1–B2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Explanations are free; optional paid e-book and course.
- [Duolingo](https://www.duolingo.com/course/nl/en/Learn-Dutch): A game-style daily habit for vocabulary and basic sentences. Great for getting started; pair it with speaking practice to progress past A2. Levels A0–A2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free with ads; Super is about €7–13 a month.
- [Babbel](https://www.babbel.com/learn-dutch): Short structured lessons with dialogues and grammar tips, taught from English. More grammar than Duolingo. Levels A0–B1. Online. Self-paced. Price: Roughly €7–15 a month depending on plan length.
- [DutchPod101](https://www.dutchpod101.com/): Audio and video lessons organised by level, with transcripts and vocabulary lists. Good for learning on a commute. Levels A0–B2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free account to start. Check the website for the paid service.
- [italki](https://www.italki.com/en/teachers/dutch): Book one-to-one video lessons with Dutch and Flemish tutors. Filter by price and specialty, such as inburgering or Staatsexamen prep. Levels A0–C2. Online. Live online class. Price: Tutors set their own rates, roughly €12–35 per hour.
- [Preply](https://preply.com/en/online/dutch-tutors): Another large tutor marketplace with many Dutch teachers. Trial lessons are discounted, so it's easy to try a few teachers. Levels A0–C2. Online. Live online class. Price: Tutors set their own rates, roughly €10–35 per hour.
- [Tandem](https://tandem.net/language-exchange/netherlands): A language-exchange app: chat with Dutch speakers who want to learn your language. Free practice in writing and, once you're braver, voice and video calls. Levels A1–C1. Online. Live online class. Price: Free; optional premium.
- [HelloTalk](https://www.hellotalk.com/en/learn/dutch): A language-exchange app: chat with Dutch speakers who are learning your language, with built-in translation and corrections. You can also post short updates for native speakers to correct. Levels A1–C1. Online. Live online class. Price: Free; optional premium.
- [Dutch language exchange meetups](https://www.meetup.com/topics/dutch-language/): Evening language exchanges in bars and cafés, organised on Meetup. Good for building confidence once you can hold a basic conversation. Levels A2–C1. Netherlands, Belgium (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Den Haag, Utrecht, Brussel, Antwerpen, Gent). In-person class. Price: Usually free or a small fee; you buy your own drinks.
- [Learn Dutch with Bart de Pau](https://www.learndutch.org/): One of the biggest Dutch-learning YouTube channels (200K+ subscribers): an animated soap opera, culture interviews and grammar videos. Free online lessons on his website, plus premium courses and virtual classrooms. Levels A0–B1. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: YouTube and basic lessons are free. Premium #dutchgrammar course €49 for one year (discounted from €79, plus VAT in the EU). Live course €495 per level (intro + 9 sessions), book extra.
- [Dutchies to be (Kim)](https://www.learndutchwithkim.com/course/courses): Kim teaches Dutch through acted, funny everyday scenes followed by the grammar behind them. Free YouTube videos, plus self-paced 3-month courses per level with lifetime access. Levels A0–B1. Online. Self-paced. Price: One-time: A1 or A2 course €79, B1 €99, A2 + B1 €159, A0–B1 package €199. Online community membership about €15–17 a month (billed in US dollars). Live lessons not included.
- [Easy Dutch](https://www.youtube.com/@EasyDutch): Street interviews with real Dutch people, subtitled in Dutch and English. Great for hearing how people actually talk. Paid memberships add podcasts, transcripts and conversation sessions. Levels A2–C1. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Videos are free on YouTube. Memberships: Basic €5, Podcast €10, Audio and Video €12, Conversation €25 a month.
- [Learn Dutch Now](https://learndutchnow.shop/): A large Instagram account (130K+ followers) with bite-sized vocabulary posts, plus downloadable courses and exam packs for the inburgering exam (A2) and Staatsexamen NT2 (B1). Levels A0–B2. Online. Self-paced. Price: One-time, lifetime access: Starter course €75, B1 course €75, both €135, Starter course + A2 exam package €199, single exam parts from €24.99.
- [Learn Dutch with Yas](https://learndutchwithyas.com/learn-dutch/dutch-mastery-group-classes): Yasmine teaches all levels: 13-week live online group classes (max 6 students), B2+ conversation classes, self-paced courses and private packages of 8 one-hour lessons. Levels A0–C2. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Instagram tips are free. 13-week group classes with Dutch Mastery Academy access: €350 excl. VAT paid at once, or 3 × €130 or 6 × €70 in instalments.
- [Learn Dutch with Charlotte](https://yourdutchfriend.org/): Charlotte posts everyday spoken Dutch on Instagram as "your Dutch friend" and runs self-paced video courses (A0–A1, A1–A2, A2–B1) and live online group classes. Levels A0–B1. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Video course €250 per level (one-time, often on sale for €199). Group classes €200 for a pack of 10. Grammar e-book €12.50.
- [Going Dutch Community](https://www.goingdutchcommunity.com/store): A large Instagram community (230K+ followers) with a paid "Road to Dutch Fluency" subscription that includes daily live classes at different levels, plus in-person events. Levels A0–B2. Online. Self-paced, Live online class, In-person class. Price: Subscription €119 a month. 6-month package with 24 private classes €1,699. Speed Dutching evenings €5; Texel summer school €950.
- [ABC Dutch](https://www.abcdutch.com/): A language school in The Hague and Rotterdam with evening and day group courses, intensive weeks, summer courses and civic integration exam preparation. Private lessons in person or on Zoom. Levels A0–C1. Netherlands (Den Haag, Rotterdam). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Group courses €270–295, civic integration exam courses €275–330, day courses €225–335. Rotterdam intensive A2 €275 a week or €1,245 for 5 weeks. Private lessons on request.
- [Sagènn Educatie](https://www.sagenn.nl/educatie): An adult education provider with Dutch courses from A0 to B2, literacy classes, civic integration routes and Staatsexamen preparation. Each course ends with a level test. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Rotterdam, Zaandam, Alphen aan den Rijn, Gouda, Utrecht, Haarlem, 's-Hertogenbosch). In-person class. Price: €415 a month for 2 lessons a week, €515 for 3, €615 for 4, from 3 months. Includes intake test, personal advice and materials. Labour market orientation course €315 a month. DUO loan possible if you're required to do inburgering. Free lessons if you aren't, in Alphen aan den Rijn, Midden-Holland, Midden-Utrecht, Zaanstreek-Waterland, Zuid-Kennemerland/IJmond, Rotterdam Rijnmond and Noordoost-Brabant.
- [NLtraining](https://www.nltraining.nl/cursussen): Dutch courses at every level in several cities and online, including free municipality-funded courses for people who aren't required to do inburgering, and paid inburgering courses. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Rotterdam, Leiden, Almere, Lelystad, Zwolle, Gouda, Hoorn, Zaandam, Barendrecht, Hellevoetsluis, Spijkenisse). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Online course €599 per 12-week module. Inburgering courses €16.25 per hour (DUO loan possible). Free "Verbeter je Nederlands" courses if you aren't required to do inburgering: Rotterdam (10–20 weeks), Leiden (12 months), and Flevoland online, Almere or Lelystad (40 weeks). Morning, afternoon or evening classes.
- [Dutch Approach](https://dutch-approach.nl/netherlands/): Small-group Dutch courses from beginner to B2, online and in classrooms in Amsterdam, Eindhoven, Taipei and Tainan: 10 weekly 2-hour classes per level, plus CNaVT exam preparation. Teaching in English and Mandarin, a good fit for learners from Taiwan. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands, Taiwan (Amsterdam, Eindhoven, Taipei, Tainan). Live online class, In-person class. Price: €339 per 10-week course, plus €30.50 for textbook and website. In Taiwan about €270 per course (NT$9,900). Check the course pages for the current term.
- [Learn with Lucas](https://learnwithlucas.com/nl/): Lucas runs online Dutch courses, a live supported-speaking café in the evenings and private lessons for speaking, grammar or the inburgering exam. Free videos on YouTube. Levels A1–B2. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Speaking café €11.99 a month (1 evening a week) or €19.99 (2 evenings), cheaper per year. Private lessons from €28. Online course prices on the website.
- [Vivo Dutch (Vivian)](https://www.vivodutch.com/): Vivian, a certified teacher since 2015 and former inburgering exam assessor, shares free lessons on Instagram (60K followers) and YouTube and runs 10-week online courses for A1, A2 and B1. Levels A0–B1. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Online course per level: DIY €187, DIY Plus €237, Premium with live classes €357 (excl. VAT, 3 installments possible). Colloquial Dutch course €37.
- [JeDutchy](https://jedutchy.com/): A certified Dutch teacher offering online group courses, private lessons, a conversation-training subscription and an inburgering masterclass. Levels A0–C1. Online. Live online class. Price: Group courses €650. Private lessons 5 × 1 h €395 or 10 × 1 h €575, trial lesson €25. Conversation training €100 a month (8 sessions). Inburgering masterclass €100.
- [Dutch Speaking Academy](https://dutchspeakingacademy.nl/): Speaking-focused video courses (beginners, inburgering A2, grammar, Dutch for parents, Dutch for social life), group conversation programmes and 1:1 coaching. Levels A0–B2. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Video courses: inburgering A2 €47, Beginners €147, Dutch for Parents or Grammar €333, Dutch for Social Life €444. Group conversation course about €3,333. 1:1 programme from €5,555 for 3 months. Speaking challenge €15.
- [Easy Dutch Learning (Sanne)](https://easydutchlearning.nl/): Sanne shares Dutch tips on Instagram (42K followers) and sells self-paced online courses for every level from A1 to C1, including NT2 and inburgering exam preparation, with a students' Instagram community. Levels A0–C1. Online. Self-paced. Price: One-time per level: A1–B2 €245, C1 €199 (the homepage shows €297). All five levels €1,485. Kids' courses €397. No subscription.
- [Hart voor Nederlands](https://hartvoornederlands.com/): A Dutch teacher offering private and duo lessons, B2 group courses, an online book club, conversation clubs and a podcast. Levels A1–C1. Online. Live online class. Price: Private lessons: 10 h €737, 15 h €981, 20 h €1,190 (book extra). Duo lessons €320–450 per person. B2 group course €450 excl. VAT. Book club €200 for 8 online sessions. Conversation club €90–120.
- [SociaTaal](https://www.sociataal.com/): Interactive online group courses in small groups (4–6 students, two 2-hour live classes a week for 6 weeks), flexible courses and self-study grammar and vocabulary courses. Levels A0–B2. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Group course €289 all-in. Flexible course €149. Grammar Essentials A1 €89 or A2 €69. Vocabulary course A1 €69.
- [Your Dutch Teacher (Emeraude)](https://yourdutchteacher.nl/): Emeraude has taught Dutch since 2009. Small online groups of 3–6 students meet twice a week for 1.5 hours, one level in 4 weeks. Tailor-made private classes too. Levels A0–B2. Online. Live online class. Price: Group course €199 per level (4 weeks). Tailor-made lessons €62.50 an hour, with discounts for 10 or 20 classes.
- [Active Dutch](https://activedutch.nl/): Dutch for expats in Alphen aan den Rijn and online: a beginners' group course, private lessons, the Keep Talking Dutch conversation club, plus a free trial lesson and a free 5-day speaking challenge. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Alphen aan den Rijn). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Beginners' group course €635 plus book. Keep Talking Dutch €145 for a month (4 sessions), €250 for 2 months, €350 for 3. Private lessons 10 × 90 min €1,200.
- [Dutch Today (Martijn)](https://www.youtube.com/@dutchtoday): Martijn's weekly Dutch lessons on YouTube and the podcast "Dutch Today: leer Nederlands met Martijn", with episodes marked by level. Levels A2–B2. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free on YouTube and podcast apps. Patreon €5 a month for transcripts, exercises, word lists and extra episodes.
- [Master Dutch (Kees)](https://masterdutch.com/group-classes/): Kees teaches with his Three Pillar Method in three formats: group classes (A1 to B+, max. 8 people, 8 weekly 90-minute sessions), 1-on-1 lesson packs and an all-in-one subscription. Levels A1–B2. Online. Live online class. Price: Group classes €255 per 8-week course. 1-on-1 lessons: 4-hour pack €260, 16-hour pack €960. All-in-one subscription €14.95 a month.
- [Nederlessen (Joram)](https://www.nederlessen.nl/): Joram teaches small online groups (max. 4) and private speaking lessons, including help with inburgering and the Staatsexamen NT2. He also sells self-study PDFs: graded story readers with grammar (A1–B1+), speaking guides, a verb guide and a KNM exam practice book, plus free cheat sheets. Levels A1–B2. Online. Self-paced, Live online class. Price: Small group €249 for 8 sessions. Private speaking lessons from €219. Self-study PDFs €5–9.99 (KNM book €9.99), with two free guides.
- [Dutch First](https://dutchfirst.nl/): A language school in Utrecht with group courses from beginner to B1, intensive summer courses, conversation courses, inburgering courses and individual lessons in class or on Zoom. Levels A0–B2. Netherlands (Utrecht). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Group courses from €350 (books extra). Summer intensives €350 for 24 hours up to €1,159 for 96 hours. Inburgering courses €17 an hour. Individual lessons in packages of 5 or more.
- [Better Understanding](https://betterunderstanding.nl/): Online Dutch group courses from A1 to B2 in groups of 3–6 (9 weeks, two 1.5-hour classes a week), private and duo lessons, and in-company training. Levels A1–B2. Online. Live online class. Price: Group course €595 for 27 hours plus €48.50 for the textbook. Private lessons €645 for 10 one-hour lessons (€322.50 each for a duo).
- [Hallo Nederlands zonder stress](https://tidycal.com/hallonederlandszonderstress): A Dutch teacher offering private lessons for B1–B2 learners and an 8-week intensive small-group course for beginners. Book directly through the online calendar. Levels A0–B2. Online. Live online class. Price: Private lessons B1–B2 €160 a month (4 bookings). Intensive beginners' small-group course €195 for 8 weeks of 1.5-hour classes.
- [Dive into Dutch](https://www.diveintodutch.nl/): A calm, structured 4-month 1:1 coaching programme: 14 online sessions of 50 minutes (or 12 plus 2 coffee sessions in The Hague, Leiden, Delft or Alphen aan den Rijn), homework, a weekly check-in, group meet-ups with other students, the Taalcompleet book with its online platform, and access to the Dive into Dutch Club. Small-group lessons too. Levels A1–B2. Online. Live online class, In-person class. Price: 1:1 programme: 4 months from €1,899, including book and club access. Coffee sessions cost extra. Small-group prices on request.
- [Zeg maar Nederlands](https://www.youtube.com/@ZegmaarNederlands): A YouTube channel about how Dutch people really speak in everyday life: recognisable dialogues, practical language tips, clear lessons and Dutch culture. The content is AI-generated: the presenters (Ling, Sam, Marieke, Jenny, Mateo and friends) are not real teachers. For beginners to advanced learners. Levels A1–C1. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free on YouTube.
- [StroopTaal](https://strooptaal.app/): An app for people living in the Netherlands, covering A0 to C1: a lesson path, word games, flashcards with daily reviews, podcasts and a culture quiz. Premium adds AI voice conversations, pronunciation scores and inburgering exam practice. Independent, not run by DUO; the interface is available in several languages. Levels A0–C1. Online. Self-paced. Price: Free basics. Plus from €7.99 a month. Premium €12.99 a month, €29.99 for 3 months, or €69.99–89.99 a year (App Store, Netherlands).
- [Dutch in Utrecht](http://dutchinutrecht.nl/): A Dutch teacher offering classes at every level, in person in Utrecht or live online: beginner and intermediate courses, custom courses built around your needs, and inburgering exam preparation. Learn alone or with friends. Levels A0–C2. Netherlands (Utrecht). In-person class, Live online class. Price: €27.50 an hour for beginner, intermediate and inburgering courses; €30 an hour for custom courses. The second and third student in a group get 40% off.
- [Lest Best](https://lestbest.nl/cursussen-overzicht/): A language school for highly educated learners in Utrecht, Rotterdam and online, with courses from A0 to C1. Choose intensive (6 weeks), semi-intensive (9 weeks) or the once-a-week "Nederlands in de praktijk" courses (13 weeks) for everyday Dutch at work and socially. Also NT2 exam training and private lessons from B1. Levels A0–C1. Netherlands (Utrecht, Rotterdam). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Nederlands in de praktijk €795 (13 weeks, once a week). Intensive (6 weeks) or semi-intensive (9 weeks) courses €1,099; evening programme or Summer School €1,045. NT2 exam training €875. Private lessons from €130 per lesson hour (at least 10 sessions of 1.5 hours, €1,950). €50 off each follow-up course, up to €150. Books extra.
- [Flowently: Daily Dutch in 30h](https://flowently.com/language-sessions/daily-dutch-in-30-h-explained/): A 30-hour beginner programme with a private tutor, online or in person: you often meet in a café and practise ordering, shopping and small talk on the spot. Covers your first 1,000 words, basic grammar and pronunciation. Sessions 7 days a week, 8:00–22:00. Levels A0–A1. Netherlands. In-person class, Live online class. Price: Trial package of 3 hours €120 (€150 for two people). Solo packages: 10 hours €750 (€75 an hour), 30 hours €1,999 (€67 an hour), 60 hours €3,960 (€66 an hour). Duo packages with a friend: 10 hours €938, 30 hours €2,562, 60 hours €4,950 (€41–47 an hour each). Valid for 1 year. Drinks during café sessions are extra.
- [Kickstart School](https://www.kickstartschool.nl/dutch-group-courses): A language school in The Hague with group courses from beginner to advanced, in the classroom (max. 10), online (max. 8) or hybrid. Once a week or semi-intensive twice a week. Also a free Kickstart School toolkit with vocabulary, grammar tips, worksheets and links to practise. Levels A0–C1. Netherlands (Den Haag). Self-paced, In-person class, Live online class. Price: Free toolkit. Once-a-week group course €420 for 24 hours (€450 from 1 January 2027), book extra (about €48.50). A0–A2 in two courses €840. Basic Dutch for au pairs €380. Students and au pairs get €40 off some courses. Semi-intensive courses (48 hours) are listed at €720, but that page shows old dates, so check with the school.
- [Dutch on Track](https://dutchontrack.nl/): Dutch courses for expats in Eindhoven, Tilburg and online, with a focus on speaking and understanding. Groups of 8–10 meet once a week for 2 hours: evenings in Eindhoven, afternoons online. New courses start every quarter, plus a one-year track from A0 to B1 and a conversation course from A2. Levels A0–B1. Netherlands (Eindhoven). In-person class, Live online class. Price: A0–A1 or A1–A2 €500 each (11 lessons of 2 hours). A2–B1 €985 (21 lessons), or 3 × €341 in instalments (€1,023). One year A0–B1 €1,786.50 paid upfront, or €1,850 in three parts. Study materials included.
- [TaalBoost](https://www.taalboost.nl/): A language school in Amsterdam (Chasséstraat) and online, with 30-hour courses from beginner to C1: evening, morning or Saturday classes online, evening classes in Amsterdam, and an intensive week for A1–A2. Also an online conversation course from B1, and private or duo lessons. Levels A0–C1. Netherlands (Amsterdam). In-person class, Live online class. Price: Online evening, morning or Saturday course €399 (30 hours in 6 or 10 weeks). Evening course in Amsterdam €549 (30 hours in 6 weeks). Intensive week in Amsterdam €549 (30 hours in 6 days). Online conversation course from B1 €249 (15 hours). Private and duo lessons: ask for a quote.
